name: RePaint-NeRF
definition: A framework for editing 3D content in NeRF using text prompts by leveraging a pre-trained diffusion model to guide changes in designated 3D content, ensuring view consistency and scene integrity.
summary: RePaint-NeRF edits 3D NeRF scenes via text prompts by iteratively updating input images with a diffusion model and retraining the NeRF, ensuring view consistency.
